# Temple Scroll Column 59 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 59 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**59:1** When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.

**59:2** There shall not be found among you anyone who makes his son or daughter pass through fire,

**59:3** or anyone who practices divination, or a soothsayer, or an augur, or a sorcerer,

**59:4** or a charmer, or a medium, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

**59:5** For everyone who does these things is an abomination to the LORD, and because of these abominations the LORD your God is driving them out before you.

**59:6** You shall be blameless before the LORD your God.

**59:7** For these nations that you are about to dispossess listen to soothsayers and diviners; but as for you, the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so.

**59:8** A prophet from among you, from your brothers, like you, I will raise up for them; and I will put My words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them everything that I command him.

**59:9** And whoever does not listen to My words that the prophet speaks in My name — I Myself will hold him accountable.

**59:10** But the prophet who presumes to speak a word in My name that I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods — that prophet shall die.

**59:11** And if you say in your heart: How can we recognize a word that the LORD has not spoken?

**59:12** When a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD and the word does not come true or come to pass, that is a word the LORD has not spoken. The prophet spoke it presumptuously; you need not fear him.

**59:13** When I cut off the nations whose land I am giving you, and you dispossess them and settle in their cities and in their houses,

**59:14** you shall set apart three cities for yourself in the midst of the land that I am giving you to possess.

**59:15** You shall prepare the roads and divide into three parts the territory of the land that I give you as an inheritance, so that every manslayer may flee there.

**59:16** This is the provision for the manslayer who flees there and lives: anyone who strikes his neighbor unintentionally, not having been his enemy in the past —

**59:17** as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood, and as his hand swings the axe to fell a tree, the iron head slips from the handle and strikes his neighbor so that he dies — he may flee to one of these cities and live.

**59:18** Otherwise the avenger of blood, in hot anger, might pursue the manslayer and overtake him because the distance is great, and strike him dead — though he did not deserve the sentence of death, since he had not been his enemy in the past.

**59:19** Therefore I command you: You shall set apart three cities for yourself.

**59:20** And if the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as He swore to your fathers, and gives you all the land that He promised to give your fathers —

**59:21** provided you faithfully observe all this commandment that I am commanding you today, to love the LORD your God and to walk in His ways always — then you shall add three more cities to these three.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows LOGOS throughout. The divination catalogue preserves traditional English terms (medium, wizard, necromancer) over PNEUMA's modernizations. "Blameless" for tamim preferred over EMET's "whole" — tamim in this context means integrity before God. "Avenger of blood" retained over PNEUMA's explanatory "dead man's relative who wants revenge." The prophet-like-Moses passage (59:8-12) is rendered with particular care given its messianic significance.*
